# Elizabethtown Epoxy Flooring

> Professional epoxy and polyaspartic floor coating contractor serving Elizabethtown, KY and surrounding communities in central Kentucky. Residential garages, basements, workshops, and commercial floors. No franchise — owner-operated, licensed, and insured.
